# sort_game_metadata

[← Command index](README.md)

Rewrite every Pegasus metadata file found under the metadata repository in sorted order.

## Synopsis

```
sort_game_metadata [options]
```

## Description

Finds every `metadata.pegasus.txt` under the `Pegasus` folder of the game metadata
repository, imports each one and exports it back to the same path. The rewrite sorts
entries by name and regenerates the collection header and launch command, which keeps
diffs small after bulk edits.

`clean_game_metadata_files` does the same but only for the known category and
subcategory paths; this tool also picks up files anywhere else under `Pegasus`.

## Options

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Sort every metadata file

```bash
sort_game_metadata
```

### List the files that would be sorted

```bash
sort_game_metadata -p
```

### Sort without the confirmation prompt

```bash
sort_game_metadata -v --no-preview
```

## Notes

- There are no selection options; every metadata file is processed.
- With `-p` the files are listed but not read or rewritten.
